caption: The drawing depicts a single upholstered armchair with high, winged sides. The chair features a colorful and elaborate upholstery pattern consisting of birds, tall palm-like trees, and various flowers. Predominant colors in the fabric include shades of turquoise blue, pink, brown, green, and some hints of red. The wooden legs and supporting crossbars of the chair are rendered in a medium brown color, with the wood grain texture visible and the legs shaped in a traditional cabriole style. The chair is set against a plain, light beige background with no other visible objects or decorations. The artist's signature, "A. Johnson," appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Easy Chair
